rationale: With only 6 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced liquidation at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that has already dropped ~16% today with a 33.8 bps spread and highly erratic 1-minute candles showing wide swings. The price is sitting just 0.75% above today's low with no clear directional momentum — the last five candles show alternating pressure with no conviction — making a reliable edge in either direction essentially absent. The account is already down on the day and the risk/reward of a 6-minute forced-close trade in a volatile, news-absent name does not justify entry.
